decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp transient offset in E/U around index 425–430 with ambiguous partial recovery, and (2) a coherent large-scale linear trend beginning abruptly at index 725 across all axes. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without clear morphological anomalies.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in E and U components (~index 425–430), with E falling ~7 MAD and U rising ~4 MAD; N shows smaller correlated dip. A possible opposing return begins around 432 but is incomplete within window; surroundings show otherwise noisy baseline.

Large, sustained linear trend in all three components from ~725 onward: N rises sharply (~3.5 to 7 MAD), E drops (~3 to 1.5 MAD), U drops (~1.5 to 0.8 MAD). The abrupt onset at 725 suggests a step or ramp; the coherent cross-axis shape (N↑, E↓, U↓) implies a physical motion rather than noise. Includes full extent of visible change and immediate pre-change context.
